query: Every weekday at 9:00 UTC, post a Slack recap of my Gmail inbox. Ask me before posting.
expected_behavior: Treat this as Build, not Operate. Discover app slugs plus FLOWRA_CREATE_OR_UPDATE_WORKFLOW.
Builder slugs run only inside FLOWRA_MULTI_EXECUTE_TOOL; do not emit FLOWRA_CREATE_OR_UPDATE_WORKFLOW as a tool name.
Put the schedule on workflow.trigger (cron), not FLOWRA_MANAGE_TRIGGER.
Insert a human_wait node before the Slack send. llm_agent nodes that feed the send need outputSchema and mappings like rank.text.
Save with runTest true. Test with FLOWRA_EXECUTE_WORKFLOW testMode true and allowExecuteWhenInactive false. In testMode, do not ask the user to approve human_wait.
Production testMode false only after the user agrees. Show viewFlowUrl.
